description: List uploads held for review. The classifier holds a file it thinks shows a secret (an API key, a password, a token) or sensitive personal data (an ID, a card number). A held file stays out of the managed PR comment, feeds, galleries, and its /f/ page, and its raw URL may 404, until a workspace member approves it with `approve`. Pass `pr`/`issue` for one PR or issue, or `prefix`. Each item has a `reason` such as `secret: api_key`. Same as `uploads approve --pr <n>`.

issue.description: Held files on this issue. Mutually exclusive with pr.

pr.description: Held files on this pull request. Mutually exclusive with issue.

workspace.description: Override the workspace for this call (like the CLI's --workspace flag).

name: list_held
title: List held files
